title: curie diff --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie diff`: every chart value the installation file and the live release disagree about, plus the values the release carries that the file does not declare. Read-only; no credential is resolved. Secret-bearing values are rendered as the literal string `<secret>` and never in the clear.

release_exists.description: False when helm has no record of the release, in which case every declared value is an `add`.

changes.description: How many entries would actually change the cluster: add, change, and reset. Deliberately excludes `unchanged` and `preserved`, so zero means applying the file is a no-op.

key.description: The dotted chart value path, in helm `--set` syntax including `[i]` array indexing.

kind.description: `preserved` means the release carries this value, the file does not declare it, and a plain `cluster up` re-supplies it anyway (Slack tokens, the GitHub App, generated store passwords). `managed by this file` means the file governs the key but its value is computed at apply time rather than stated literally (a resolved egress CIDR, the model credential and the fake-model switch it rides with). Neither is a pending removal. `reset to chart default` is the genuine loss case: undeclared, not governed, and not carried forward.

from.description: The live value, or null when the release does not have this key. `<secret>` when the key carries a credential.

to.description: The declared value, or null when the file does not declare this key. `<secret>` when the key carries a credential.
